name: @anyblades/blades

scripts.build: clear; npm run lint && npm run build:css && npm run build:minify && npm run build:conditional && npm run build:layered
scripts.build:css: for f in src/[!_]*.css; do RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 lightningcss --bundle $f -o css/${f#src/} || exit 1; done
scripts.build:minify: for f in css/*.css; do case $f in *.min.css|css/pico.conditional.*) ;; *) lightningcss --minify $f -o ${f%.css}.min.css || exit 1;; esac; done
scripts.build:layered: npm run build:layered:css && npm run build:layered:wrap && npm run build:layered:clean
scripts.build:layered:css: rm -rf css/layered && for d in pico blades; do for f in $(find src/$d -name '_*.css' ! -path src/$d/_index.css); do o=css/layered/${f#src/$d/}; mkdir -p ${o%/*} && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 lightningcss --bundle $f -o $o || exit 1; done; done

description: Fully compatible and actively maintained successor to Pico CSS.
